Fable 5.1 refuses forced tool_choice, binds thinking blocks to model+prefix (thinking.block_binding), and reads its cache at $0.25/MTok. context_window is LIVE: context_window_for_canonical consults the declared sources (custom-provider declaration, then this catalog) before the name-shape guesses, so this row is authoritative. Google Antigravity backend registry, read 2026-08-20 via cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:fetchAvailableModels. That registry is the serving list: it publishes gemini-3.6-flash-low/-medium/-high, gemini-3.5-flash-extra-low/-low, gemini-3.1-pro-low, gemini-3-flash-agent and gemini-pro-agent, and carries NO bare gemini-3.6-flash / gemini-3.5-flash / gemini-3.x-pro id at all — the reasoning tier is part of the model id. Display names in that response map gemini-3-flash-agent to "Gemini 3.5 Flash (High)", and deprecatedModelIds redirects gemini-3.1-pro-high to gemini-pro-agent, which is why those two ids carry the high rung. No context window is declared here: the registry does not publish one, and inventing a figure is exactly what this catalog forbids.

OpenAI o-series reasoning models (o1, o3, o4 and their -mini/-pro members by segment prefix): on the Chat Completions wire they take reasoning_effort and max_completion_tokens and reject max_tokens, which is the only fact openai_compat::is_reasoning_model reads. Effort set per the o-series docs: low|medium|high. No context window or class is declared — the row exists so an OpenAI-compatible gateway serving these ids gets the reasoning wire shape without a name-prefix rule in code.

The bare gpt-5 release and its dated members (gpt-5-2025-08-07) by segment prefix: the same reasoning wire shape as the o-series. Later gpt-5.x releases carry their own rows (5.3 codex spark, 5.5, 5.6) and discovery publishes newer ones, so this row is only the base release.

priors.source: Cold-start name-token guesses for a model no provider has positioned: read only when a row declares no `class` and the effort ceiling does not decide, and recorded as TiersProvenance::Fallback. A published layer (operator export, model-catalog.json, discovery) may declare any field; the first layer that fills a field wins and the rest come from here.

plan.source: Cold-start figures for the plan scorer (runtime::score_plan); the verified outcome record replaces each as evidence accumulates (CONFIDENT_DECISIVE_SAMPLES). MEASURED: judge_output_tokens = median code-reviewer output in the zerocode store, 26.6k (docs/design/zo-orchestration-accuracy-and-learning.md §8, 2026-09-10); classify_output_tokens/classify_ms = the probe's own caps (tools smart_router probe_exec.rs, 512 tokens / 8 s); medium work turn = zo medians of the r50 bench's seven tasks, out 7,551 tok / 9 requests / 114 s (zo-ide/docs/analysis/turn-axis-r50.md §6, 2026-09-10). ESTIMATES awaiting a measurement: pass percents by band; judge_duration_ms; objective_check_ms; lane_brief_tokens; handover_tokens; the trivial/small/large/unknown turns (scaled from medium). A published layer may override any figure; the first layer that fills it wins.

facts.priors: The router's cold-start tables: name tokens (small / frontier family / deep flagship), formerly literals in runtime::model_inventory, and the per-role specialty seed (route role key -> lineage families), formerly a literal table in runtime::model_router::policy; see the section's own `source`.
facts.priors.plan: The plan scorer's cold-start figures (pass rate per band, work-turn size per complexity, judge/check/classify/brief/handover costs); see that section's `source` for which are measured and which are estimates.
facts.effort_levels: Codex models_cache.json supported_reasoning_levels (2026-09-05) for OpenAI; Anthropic effort docs (xhigh on Fable/Opus/Sonnet 5, Haiku low|medium|high|max); Gemini 3 thinkingLevel low|medium|high.
facts.capabilities: imagegen: ChatGPT backend image generation on the current GPT lineup; streaming_only: Codex Spark cannot serve non-stream requests; no_vision: Model does not accept image inputs (text/code only, e.g. Codex Spark).
facts.fast_pair: Release-specific priority-tier spelling when it is not `<id>[fast]`.
facts.demotes_to: One-step rate-limit fallback for an id that is not a family alias's canonical.
facts.refusal_fallback: Where a safety-classifier refusal on this lineup goes next, as one alias or an ordered list of them (an alias row carries its family's; a model row carries a retired lineup's). The head that shares this provider is retried on the bound client; a cross-provider candidate is handed the turn like a quota fallback, skipping any whose provider is not connected. Absent: a refusal is surfaced after one same-model retry. The runtime names no lineup for this.
facts.refusal_routes: Where a safety-classifier refusal on this lineup goes, per the category the classifier names (cyber, bio, frontier_llm, reasoning_extraction, general_harms): the provider's own routing, by model id and never by a family alias that moves (Claude Code 2.1.281 routes cyber from Fable 5.1, Opus 5 and Opus 5.5 to Opus 4.8, and bio from Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5 — and frontier_llm from Opus 5.5 — to Opus 5; a route naming the refusing model itself is skipped, so Opus 5's own bio refusal goes on across providers). A category absent here is routed nowhere and its refusal stands; a refusal naming no category stands too. Absent altogether: refusal_fallback answers for every category. Measured t-6747.
